ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New accounts, Needs confirmed and later stages need Specification confirmed, Annual volume estimate and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_accounts", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "First contact", 2, "Needs confirmed", 3, "Sample or trial", 4, "Quote issued", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 3, OR(NOT(Spec_confirmed__c), ISBLANK(Annual_volume_estimate__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Specification confirmed, Annual volume estimate and Next step date before moving to Needs confirmed.
